title: wallets.credits
description: Credits <-> money of one wallet (BE-WL-1..5). From credits: amount = round_half_away(credits x rate_amount, exponent); amount_cents = amount x 10^exponent (integer); credits returned = amount / rate_amount for invoiceable credits (computed in binary floating point), the input credits otherwise; rounds_to_zero = credits floored to 5 places > 0 but amount_cents = 0. From cents: cents rounded half away to an integer, amount = that / 10^exponent, credits = amount / rate_amount.
